command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(id -un); machinectl shell entityos /bin/sh -lc 'echo VM_HOST=$(hostname); echo ===DBS===; find /var/lib/entityos /opt/entityos /home -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name unified.db -o -name "*.sqlite" -o -name "*.db" \) -printf "%s %p\n" 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -40; echo ===GRID===; find /opt/entityos /var/lib/entityos /home -maxdepth 7 -type f \( -name "*grid10*" -o -name "stern.py" -o -name "gespraech_loop.py" \) -printf "%p\n" 2>/dev/null | head -80'
